t: You're on Lower Grosvenor Place, a street in the City of Westminster. Charles Greville was born here in 1911. He became the 7th Earl of Warwick, and he was the last Earl to live at the family seat, Warwick Castle, before it was sold in 1978. He also became the first British aristocrat to star in a Hollywood movie, and the local press later nicknamed him the Duke of Hollywood. So a Westminster street gave London a boy who ended up with both a castle and a film career.
